title: Cook a new recipe together
description: Pick a cuisine neither of you has tried cooking before and follow a recipe from scratch.

title: Sunset picnic
description: Pack snacks and find a spot to watch the sunset together, phones away.

title: Museum or gallery afternoon
description: Wander a local museum or art gallery and rate each exhibit out of 10.

title: Recreate your first date
description: Go back to where you had your first date, or recreate it as closely as you can.

title: Stargazing drive
description: Drive somewhere with low light pollution, bring blankets, and just look up.

title: Two-player video game night
description: Pick a co-op or competitive game neither of you has played and learn it together.

title: Local trivia night
description: Find a bar or venue hosting trivia and team up.

title: Build a blanket fort and marathon a show
description: Full blanket fort, snacks, and a season of something you've both been meaning to watch.

title: Weekend farmers market crawl
description: Visit a farmers market, try samples, and cook whatever looks best that night.

title: Book a couples massage or spa hour
description: Treat yourselves to an hour of side-by-side relaxation.
